name: hollow_bushing
why: A hollow profile: the ring from R20 to R10, 30 high. It is the case in which the profile does not touch the axis, and the solid that comes out is a tube -- if the outline were closed on the axis a full cylinder would come out, and the volume would say so.

expect.tolerance_why: pi*(20^2 - 10^2)*30: the calculation has pi inside
